# SC2016: mixed-multi-provider-scopes

## Meaning

The compiler emitted this diagnostic for mixed multi provider scopes. The declaration or generated contract violates a statically checkable SupaCloud rule.

## Fix

Give all contributions to a multi token the same scope. Use separate tokens for different lifetimes.

## Reproduction

Place the example below in a focused compiler fixture and assert that `SC2016` is reported with a file location. The fixture must fail before the fix and pass after it.

## Failing Example

```ts
// Expected diagnostic: SC2016
@Module({ name: "feature", providers: [
  { provide: ITEMS, useValue: "a", multi: true, scope: "application" },
  { provide: ITEMS, useValue: "b", multi: true, scope: "request" },
] }) class Feature {}
```
